            return False
    
    def update_vscode_tab_title(title_text: str):
        """Pousse la sÃ©quence d'Ã©chappement console OSC 0 sur CONOUT$ et Win32."""
        if os.name == "nt":
            try:
                import ctypes
                ctypes.windll.kernel32.SetConsoleTitleW(str(title_text))
            except Exception:
                pass
        osc_seq = f"\x1b]0;{title_text}\x07\x1b]2;{title_text}\x07"
        try:
            if os.name == "nt":
                with open("CONOUT$", "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tty:
                    tty.write(osc_seq)
        parent_pid = None
        parent_name = ""
        try:
            import session_statusline
            parent_pid, parent_name = session_statusline.get_ancestor_cli_process()
            conv_id = session_statusline.find_current_conversation_id(parent_name, parent_pid)
            if not conv_id:
                raise ValueError("ID natif non rÃ©solu")
            current_alias = ""
            if not replay_existing:
                current_alias, _ = session_statusline.get_session_info(conv_id, parent_name)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"âŒ Session courante non identifiÃ©e : {e}\n")
            sys.exit(3)
    
        if not conv_id:
            sys.stderr.write("âŒ Session courante non identifiÃ©e ; aucun renommage appliquÃ©. VÃ©rifie l'ID natif du CLI.\n")
            sys.exit(3)
    
        parent_lower = (parent_name or "").lower()
        if not any(cli in parent_lower for cli in ("claude", "agy", "dsh", "codex")):
            sys.stderr.write(f"âŒ CLI courant non reconnu ({parent_name or 'inconnu'}) ; aucun renommage appliquÃ©.\n")
            sys.exit(3)
    
        # 3. Alias machine canonique, identique dans le Superviseur et le prÃ©fixe du chat.
        actor = "AGY01" if "agy" in parent_lower else ("CC01" if "claude" in parent_lower else ("DSH01" if "dsh" in parent_lower else "CDX01"))
        platform_code = "claude" if "claude" in parent_lower else ("agy" if "agy" in parent_lower else ("dsh" if "dsh" in parent_lower else "codex"))
    
        if replay_existing:
            fallback_alias = get_last_committed_alias(conv_id)
            try:
                linked_session = get_linked_supervisor_session(conv_id, platform_code, timeout=1.0)
            except SupervisorSessionNotLinked as e:
                old_alias = fallback_alias or "NONE"
                log_audit("INTENT", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=0)
                log_audit("REJECTED", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=4)
                sys.stderr.write(f"âŒ {e}. Aucun titre modifiÃ©.\n")
                sys.exit(4)
            if not linked_session:
                old_alias = fallback_alias or "NONE"
                log_audit("INTENT", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=0)
                log_audit("FAILED", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=1)
                sys.stderr.write("âŒ Superviseur indisponible ; aucun titre modifiÃ©.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
    
            machine_alias = str(linked_session.get("alias") or fallback_alias).strip()
            canonical_title = str(linked_session.get("display_title") or machine_alias).strip()
            if not RE_MACHINE_ALIAS.fullmatch(machine_alias):
                old_alias = machine_alias or fallback_alias or "NONE"
                log_audit("INTENT", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=0)
                log_audit("REJECTED", conv_id, old_alias, old_alias, status_code=4)
                sys.stderr.write("âŒ Alias existant absent ou invalide ; aucun titre modifiÃ©.\n")
                sys.exit(4)
            if not canonical_title:
                canonical_title = machine_alias
            current_alias = machine_alias
            description = ""
            log_audit("INTENT", conv_id, current_alias, machine_alias, status_code=0)
        else:
            if re.fullmatch(r"^T\d+(-[0-9A-Z]+)?-(CC|AGY|CDX|DSH|OPC|GLM|MMX|QWN)\d{2}$", task_id):
                machine_alias = task_id
            else:
                machine_alias = f"{task_id}-{actor}"
            # T429 (2026-11-13) : le titre canonique porte le titre officiel de la tache ;
            # la designation libre de l'exploitant reste visible entre parentheses.
            task_title = resolve_task_title(task_id)
            if task_title:
                canonical_title = f"{machine_alias} Â· {task_title}"
                if description:
                    canonical_title += f" ({description})"
            else:
                canonical_title = f"{machine_alias} {description}".strip()
    
        if preflight_only:
            try:
                assignment_id = resolve_supervisor_session_id(conv_id, platform_code, timeout=1.0)
            except SupervisorSessionNotLinked as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"âŒ PrÃ©vol refusÃ© : {e}. Aucun titre ni alias modifiÃ©.\n")
                sys.exit(4)
            if not assignment_id:
                sys.stderr.write("âŒ PrÃ©vol impossible : Superviseur indisponible ; aucun titre ni alias modifiÃ©.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            print(f"âœ… PrÃ©vol PASS : {platform_code}:{conv_id} reliÃ©e ; cible '{canonical_title}'. Aucun changement appliquÃ©.")
            sys.exit(0)

    def update_claude_transcript_title(session_id: str, new_title: str):
        """Met Ã  jour le titre 'ai-title' dans le transcript Claude Code pour que /status affiche le bon nom."""
        try:
            projects_dir = Path.home() / ".claude" / "projects"
            if not projects_dir.exists():
                return
            matches = list(projects_dir.glob(f"**/{session_id}.jsonl"))
            for transcript_path in matches:
                line_payload = json.dumps({"type": "ai-title", "aiTitle": new_title, "sessionId": session_id}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
                with open(transcript_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(line_payload)
                    f.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    
    def update_codex_thread_title(thread_id: str, new_title: str, timeout: float = 4.0) -> bool:
        """Renomme le titre de chat Codex par son API app-server locale, puis vÃ©rifie l'index."""
        try:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                ["codex", "app-server", "--stdio"],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                bufsize=1,
            )
            output_lines: queue.Queue[str | None] = queue.Queue()
    
            def read_stdout():
                try:
                    for line in process.stdout:
                        output_lines.put(line)
                finally:
                    output_lines.put(None)
    
            threading.Thread(target=read_stdout, daemon=True).start()
    
            def send(payload: dict):
                process.stdin.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                process.stdin.flush()
    
            def read_response(expected_id: int) -> dict:
                deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
                while True:
                    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                    if remaining <= 0:
                        raise TimeoutError("Codex app-server n'a pas rÃ©pondu Ã  temps")
                    line = output_lines.get(timeout=remaining)
                    if line is None:
                        raise RuntimeError("Codex app-server a fermÃ© le flux avant la rÃ©ponse")
                    try:
                        message = json.loads(line)
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        continue
                    if message.get("id") == expected_id:
                        if message.get("error"):
                            raise RuntimeError(str(message["error"]))
                        return message
    
            send({
                "id": 1,
                "method": "initialize",
                "params": {"clientInfo": {"name": "rename-session", "title": "Rename Session", "version": "1.0.0"}},
            })
            read_response(1)
            send({"method": "initialized", "params": {}})
            send({"id": 2, "method": "thread/name/set", "params": {"threadId": thread_id, "name": new_title}})
            read_response(2)
            process.stdin.close()
            process.wait(timeout=timeout)
    
            index_path = Path.home() / ".codex" / "session_index.jsonl"
            if not index_path.is_file():
                return False
            deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                try:
                    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
                    match = next((row for row in reversed(rows) if row.get("id") == thread_id), None)
                    if match and match.get("thread_name") == new_title:
                        return True
                except Exception:
                    pass
                time.sleep(0.05)
            return False
        except Exception:
            try:
                process.terminate()
                process.wait(timeout=1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return False
    
    def main():
        preflight_only = "--preflight" in sys.argv[1:]
        control_flags = {"--preflight"}
        raw_args = " ".join(arg for arg in sys.argv[1:] if arg not in control_flags).strip()
        replay_existing = not raw_args and not preflight_only
    
        if not raw_args and not replay_existing:
            sys.stderr.write("âŒ Erreur : paramÃ¨tre manquant pour le prÃ©flight.\n")
            sys.stderr.write("Usage : rename_session.py [<TXXX[-ACTEUR]> <Description>]\n")
            sys.exit(2)
    
        # 1. Validation & Assainissement (sauf rejeu du nom existant).
        if not replay_existing:
            try:
                task_id, target_alias, description = sanitize_and_validate(raw_args)
            except ValueError as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"âŒ Erreur de validation : {e}\n")
                sys.exit(2)
    
        # 2. DÃ©tection de la session courante via session_statusline
        sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "TOOLS" / "AGENT_WORKFLOW" / "scripts"))
        parent_pid = None
        parent_name = ""
        try:
            import session_statusline

    def test_notify_supervisor_keeps_chat_name_and_explicit_folder_together(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        tasks_dir = tmp_path / "DOC" / "WFLOW" / "TASKS"
        task_dir = tasks_dir / "T000_CHALLENGE_M3_SIMULATION_AGY02"
        task_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        (task_dir / "README.md").write_text("Session `T000-AGY02`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        monkeypatch.setattr(rename_session, "REPO_ROOT", tmp_path)
    
        class FakeResponse:
            status = 200
            def __init__(self, data=b'{"schema_version":1,"running":true,"sessions":[]}'):
                self.data = data
            def read(self):
                return self.data
            def __enter__(self):
                return self
            def __exit__(self, *args):
                pass
    
        calls = []
        def fake_urlopen(req, timeout=1.0):
            calls.append(req)
            if req.get_method() == "GET":
                if req.full_url.endswith("/summary"):
                    return FakeResponse(b'{"sessions":[{"id":"supervisor-id","platform":"agy","native_id":"conversation-id"}]}')
                return FakeResponse(b'{"token":"test-token"}')
            return FakeResponse()
    
        import urllib.request
        monkeypatch.setattr(urllib.request, "urlopen", fake_urlopen)
    
        result = rename_session.notify_supervisor(
            "conversation-id",
            "T000-AGY02",
            mission_text="GEMINI 4 HYDRO CHALLENGE SIMU M3",
            platform="agy",
        )
    
        assert result is True
        assert len(calls) == 4
        alias_payload = json.loads(calls[2].data.decode("utf-8"))
        assert alias_payload["id"] == "supervisor-id"
        mission_payload = json.loads(calls[3].data.decode("utf-8"))
        assert mission_payload["action"] == "set_mission"
        assert mission_payload["id"] == "supervisor-id"
        assert mission_payload["mission"] == (
            "T000-AGY02 GEMINI 4 HYDRO CHALLENGE SIMU M3 â€” "
            "Dossier: T000_CHALLENGE_M3_SIMULATION_AGY02"
        )

    def test_rename_uses_real_supervisor_assignment_id_for_alias_and_mission(tmp_path, platform, actor):
        """Reproduit connect puis rename contre le vrai serveur local isolÃ©."""
        import threading
        from urllib.request import urlopen
    
        from TOOLS.AGENT_SUPERVISOR.scripts.connect_session import connect
        from TOOLS.AGENT_SUPERVISOR.scripts.supervisor_server import create_server
    
        native_id = "a1234567-b89c-40d1-a234-567890abcdef"
        source_root = tmp_path / platform
        source_root.mkdir()
        source_name = f"{native_id}.jsonl" if platform == "claude" else f"rollout-2026-11-13T00-00-00-{native_id}.jsonl"
        (source_root / source_name).write_text("{}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    
        server = create_server(port=0, state_path=tmp_path / "supervisor-state.json")
        server.supervision.roots = {"claude": [], "codex": [], "agy": [], "dsh": []}
        server.supervision.roots[platform] = [source_root]
        server.supervision.command({"action": "start"})
        worker = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        worker.start()
        base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
        try:
            alias = f"T423-{actor}01"
            linked = connect(platform, native_id, alias, "T423", "Mission initiale", base_url)
            assert linked["status"] == "attached"
    
            assert rename_session.notify_supervisor(
                native_id,
                alias,
                mission_text="Hydro M3",
                platform=platform,
                base_url=base_url,
            ) is True
    
            with urlopen(base_url + "/api/supervision") as response:
                snapshot = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
            assignment = next(item for item in snapshot["sessions"] if item["native_id"] == native_id)
            assert assignment["id"] == linked["assignment_id"]
            assert assignment["alias"] == alias
            # T429 (2026-11-13) : le titre officiel de la tache porte le titre de session.
            task_title = rename_session.resolve_task_title(alias)
            assert task_title, "le titre officiel de la tache doit etre resolu"
            assert assignment["mission"].splitlines()[0] == f"{alias} Hydro M3"
            assert f"Tache : {task_title}" in assignment["mission"]
            with urlopen(base_url + "/api/supervision/summary") as response:
                summary = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
            displayed = next(item for item in summary["sessions"] if item["native_id"] == native_id)
            assert displayed["display_title"] == f"{alias} Hydro M3"
        finally:
            server.supervision.close()
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
            worker.join(timeout=2)

    import pytest
    
    from TOOLS.AGENT_SUPERVISOR.scripts.supervisor_server import create_server
    from TOOLS.AGENT_SUPERVISOR.scripts.supervisor_service import Supervisor
    
    
    def test_storage_lock_rejects_second_server(tmp_path):
        state = tmp_path / 'state.json'
        first = create_server(0, state)
        try:
            with pytest.raises(OSError):
                create_server(0, state)
        finally:
            first.supervision.close()
            first.server_close()
        second = create_server(0, state)
        second.supervision.close()
        second.server_close()
    
    
    def test_invalid_configuration_is_not_overwritten(tmp_path):
        state = tmp_path / 'state.json'
        state.write_text('{broken', encoding='utf-8')
        service = Supervisor(state)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ecriture refusee'):
            service.command({'action': 'configure', 'model': 'local', 'allow_cloud': False})
        assert state.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == '{broken'
        service.close()

    class SupervisorSessionNotLinked(RuntimeError):

    def get_linked_supervisor_session(session_id: str, platform: str,
                                      base_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8082",
                                      timeout: float = 1.0) -> dict | None:
        """Return the exact existing assignment; None means the service is unavailable."""
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{base_url}/api/supervision/summary",
            headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
            method="GET",
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
                summary = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return None
    
        linked = [
            item for item in summary.get("sessions", [])
            if item.get("platform") == platform and item.get("native_id") == session_id
        ]
        if not linked:
            raise SupervisorSessionNotLinked(
                f"Session {platform}:{session_id} is not linked to Supervisor"
            )
        if len(linked) != 1:
            raise SupervisorSessionNotLinked(
                f"Multiple Supervisor assignments match {platform}:{session_id}"
            )
        if not linked[0].get("id"):
            raise SupervisorSessionNotLinked("Supervisor assignment has no internal ID")
        return linked[0]
    
    
    def get_last_committed_alias(session_id: str) -> str:
        """Return the latest successful alias logged for this native session ID."""
        if not AUDIT_LOG_FILE.exists():
            return ""
        pattern = re.compile(
            r"^\[[^\]]+\] \[COMMIT\] \[" + re.escape(session_id)
            + r"\] '[^']*' -> '([^']*)' \(code=0\)$"
        )
        try:
            for line in reversed(AUDIT_LOG_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()):
                match = pattern.match(line.strip())
                if match:
                    return match.group(1).strip()
        except Exception:
            return ""
        return ""

    def get_session_info(conv_id, cli_name: str = "agy"):
        raw_title = ""
        actor = "AGY01" if "agy" in (cli_name or "") else ("CC01" if "claude" in (cli_name or "") else "CDX01")
    
        # 1. Si session rattachÃ©e au Superviseur : l'alias vÃ©rifiÃ© est prioritaire
        if conv_id:
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/supervision/summary")
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=0.15) as resp:
                    data = json.load(resp)
                    for s in data.get("sessions", []):
                        if s.get("native_id") == conv_id:
                            alias = s.get("alias", "")
                            if alias:
                                alias = alias.strip()
                                raw_title = s.get("display_title", "").strip() or alias
                                break
            except Exception:
                pass
    
        # 2. Si Claude Code : lire le dernier ai-title dans le transcript
        if not raw_title and "claude" in (cli_name or "").lower() and conv_id:
            try:
                projects_dir = Path.home() / ".claude" / "projects"
                if projects_dir.exists():
                    for tp in projects_dir.glob(f"**/{conv_id}.jsonl"):
                        with open(tp, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                            for line in f:
                                try:
                                    d = json.loads(line)
                                    if d.get("type") == "ai-title" and d.get("aiTitle"):
                                        raw_title = d.get("aiTitle").strip()
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                        if raw_title:
                            break
            except Exception:
                pass
    
        # 3. Si Antigravity : vÃ©rifier si /rename dans SQLite est plus rÃ©cent
        if not raw_title and "agy" in (cli_name or "").lower():
            db_file = APP_DATA / "conversation_summaries.db"
            if db_file.exists():
                try:
                    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_file), timeout=0.15)
                    cur = conn.cursor()
                    if conv_id:
                        cur.execute("SELECT title FROM conversation_summaries WHERE conversation_id = ?", (conv_id,))
                        row = cur.fetchone()
                        if row and row[0]:
                            raw_title = row[0].strip()
                    conn.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
    
        return raw_title, actor

            stdin_transcript = None
            if not sys.stdin.isatty():
                try:
                    stdin_data = sys.stdin.read()
                    if stdin_data:
                        parsed = json.loads(stdin_data)
                        stdin_session_id = parsed.get("session_id") or parsed.get("sessionId")
                        stdin_transcript = parsed.get("transcript_path")
                except Exception:
                    pass
    
            # DÃ©terminer le mode d'appel (--mode title ou --mode statusline)
            mode = "statusline"
            if "--mode" in sys.argv:
                try:
                    idx = sys.argv.index("--mode")
                    mode = sys.argv[idx + 1].lower()
                except Exception:
                    pass
    
            parent_pid, parent_name = get_ancestor_cli_process()
            conv_id = find_current_conversation_id(parent_name, parent_pid, stdin_session_id)
            raw_title, actor = get_session_info(conv_id, parent_name)
            boot_name = get_boot_terminal_name(parent_name)
    
            # Extraire le repÃ¨re canonique de tÃ¢che (TXXX ou TXXX-ACTEUR ex: T423 ou T423-AGY01 ou T000-AGY00)
            task_id = None
            if raw_title:
                m = re.match(r"^(T\d+(?:-[0-9A-Z]+)*)", raw_title, re.IGNORECASE)
                if not m:
                    m = re.search(r"\b(T\d+(?:-[0-9A-Z]+)*)\b", raw_title, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m:
                    task_id = m.group(1).upper()
    
            tab_title = f"{raw_title.strip()} {boot_name}" if raw_title else boot_name
            # T429 : ecriture VERIFIEE (ecrire -> relire -> reessayer -> consigner).
            # Le statusline revient apres les commandes outil : reappliquer le titre ici
            # resiste au titre du shell enfant, et la verification prouve le resultat.
            try:
                terminal_title.refresh(conv_id, tab_title)
            except Exception:
                set_terminal_title(tab_title)
    
            # Sortie pour la commande :
            if mode == "title":
                # Mode 'title' : uniquement le repÃ¨re et le nom de boot Ã©purÃ©
                print(tab_title)
            else:
                # Mode 'statusLine' CLI : stylÃ© avec couleurs ANSI selon les conventions du projet
                # TXXX-ACTEUR : Bleu vif / Cyan
                # DÃ©signation : Violet pastel clair / lavande (haute lisibilitÃ© sur fond sombre)
                # Couleurs d'identification stricte par famille d'agent :
                # CC : Rouge / Corail
                # AGY : Bleu azur (Gemini / Antigravity)
                # CDX : Vert Ã©meraude (Codex)
                # DSH : Cyan / Bleu turquoise (DeepSeek baleine)
                # GLM : Magenta / Violet (GLM-4 / GLM-5)
                # MMX : Jaune ambre (MiniMax)

    def session_display_title(session):
        """Return the canonical display title without exposing arbitrary mission text."""
        alias = str(session.get("alias", "")).strip()
        display_title = str(session.get("display_title", "")).strip()
        if display_title:
            return display_title[:200]
        mission = str(session.get("mission", "")).strip()
        lines = mission.splitlines()
        title_line = lines[0].strip() if lines else ""
        # Legacy T000 missions had a metadata header before the display title. Accept only
        # this known shape; never search arbitrary mission/objective lines for alias-like text.
        if (alias and title_line.casefold().startswith(("tÃ¢che / sujet :", "tache / sujet :"))
                and len(lines) > 1 and lines[1].strip().startswith(alias + " ")):
            title_line = lines[1].strip()
        if alias and title_line.startswith(alias + " "):
            return title_line.partition("Dossier:")[0].partition(" â€”")[0].rstrip().strip()[:200]
        return alias[:200]

J’ai identifié une collision concrète dans ta config Codex : `shift-/` est lié à l’action **copier**. Sur ton clavier, la combinaison qui produit `/` peut donc déclencher la copie. Je retire ce raccourci et garde `Ctrl+O` comme raccourci de copie, puis je vérifie la config TOML.

## Activity

    $ @'
        from pathlib import Path
        p = Path(r'C:\Users\ZEDVICTUS\.codex\config.toml')
        b = p.read_bytes()
        s = b.decode('utf-8')
        old = 'copy = ["ctrl-o", "shift-/"]'
        new = 'copy = ["ctrl-o"]'
        count = s.count(old)
        if count != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'Expected one copy binding, found {count}; file unchanged')
        p.write_bytes(s.replace(old, new, 1).encode('utf-8'))
        print('Updated global Codex copy binding: shift-/ removed; ctrl-o preserved.')
        '@ | python -; @'

        """Renomme le titre de chat Codex par son API app-server locale, puis vÃ©rifie l'index."""
        try:

                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                bufsize=1,
            )
            output_lines: queue.Queue[str | None] = queue.Queue()
    
            def read_stdout():
                try:
                    for line in process.stdout:
                        output_lines.put(line)
                finally:
                    output_lines.put(None)
    
            threading.Thread(target=read_stdout, daemon=True).start()
    
            def send(payload: dict):
                process.stdin.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                process.stdin.flush()
    
            def read_response(expected_id: int) -> dict:
                deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
                while True:
                    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                    if remaining <= 0:
                        raise TimeoutError("Codex app-server n'a pas rÃ©pondu Ã  temps")
                    line = output_lines.get(timeout=remaining)
                    if line is None:
                        raise RuntimeError("Codex app-server a fermÃ© le flux avant la rÃ©ponse")
                    try:

                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        continue
                    if message.get("id") == expected_id:
                        if message.get("error"):
                            raise RuntimeError(str(message["error"]))
                        return message

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Gate du contrat de tache : refuse les objectifs non testables.
    
    Classe de bug couverte (REX 2026-07-29) : sur 53 taches deleguees, les
    criteres d'acceptation etaient 3 phrases generiques reutilisees telles quelles
    ("implement the requested change without widening scope"). Un agent rendait donc
    un rapport Â« conforme Â» a rien. On peut rendre une verification obligatoire :
    si elle ne porte sur aucun objectif, elle reste creuse.
    
    Ce script verifie qu'un contrat existe et qu'il est REELLEMENT specifique :
    
      T1  contrat present et exploitable a partir de C2
      T2  objectif metier renseigne (pas le gabarit)
      T3  au moins un critere d'acceptation, chacun avec un `verified_by` concret
      T4  aucun critere generique (liste noire issue des 53 taches observees)
      T5  perimetre declare (allowed / forbidden)
      T6  contrat de conservation present et rempli si strategy = rebuild
      T7  preuves attendues declarees
      T8  une tache touchant CODE/MAIN declare les deux preuves structurelles :
          nom de fichier = nom de POU et suffixe de langage = langage bundle
      T9  execution_plan present des C2 : au moins un jalon avec title et
          done_when non vides (T427-AC3 ; defaut = WARN, T426-AC7)
      T10 chaque entree test_feedback tient sur une ligne <= 120 caracteres :
          le sas d'essais n'accepte ni code a chaud ni paragraphe (T427-AC3)
      T11 tracking.budget coherent (0 <= used <= total, 1 <= parallel_max <=
          total) et companion_doc cite comme chemin de projet sans restes de
          gabarit â€” l'existence physique du fichier relve de G530 (T427-AC3)
    
    Usage :
      python TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/scripts/check_task_contract.py <TASK_CONTEXT.yaml>
      python TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/scripts/check_task_contract.py <fichier> --release
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import os
    import re
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    
    # Formulations observees dans les artefacts de sous-agents : elles ne disent rien
    # de ce que le code doit FAIRE. Un critere qui ressemble a ca est refuse.
    GENERIC_PATTERNS = [
        r"without widening scope",
        r"implement the requested change",
        r"return evidence sufficient",
        r"return concrete findings",
        r"independent acceptance review",
        r"^\s*(le code|la fonction)?\s*(fonctionne|marche|est correct)\s*\.?\s*$",
        r"^\s*(ok|conforme|valide|termine)\s*\.?\s*$",
        r"respecte(r)? les (regles|standards|conventions)",
        r"sans regression",
    ]
    
    # Restes de gabarit : si on les retrouve, le contrat n'a pas ete rempli.
    PLACEHOLDERS = ["â€¦", "...", "LOT_XX", "FB_Xxx", "Comportement observable attendu",
                    "En une phrase :", "commande exacte, test PLC"]
    
    CRITICALITY_REQUIRING_CONTRACT = {"C2", "C3", "C4"}
    # Seuil du sas d'essais (T427-AC2) : une entree test_feedback = 1 ligne courte.
    TEST_FEEDBACK_MAX_CHARS = 120
    
    # Un contrat touchant un PROGRAM doit rendre les deux controles structurels
    # explicites AVANT ecriture. Ce gate ne parse jamais le code : il valide que
    # l'orchestrateur a formule les preuves attendues dans le contrat.
    STRUCTURAL_SCOPE_PREFIXES = ("CODE/M_MAIN/", "CODE/MAIN/")
    # Une cooccurrence de mots est insuffisante : l'operateur relationnel doit
    # relier LOCALement les deux termes. Les motifs interdisent notamment de faire
    # passer Â« fichier est identique dans la revue ; POU documente Â» : un point, un
    # point-virgule ou un retour ligne coupe la relation.
    EQUALITY = r"(?:=|est\s+)?(?:identique|egal|Ã©gale?|correspond(?:ance)?|associe)"
    LOCAL = r"[^.;\n]{0,50}"
    FILE_POU_RELATIONS = (
        re.compile(rf"\b(?:nom\s+d(?:e|u)\s+)?fichier\b{LOCAL}{EQUALITY}{LOCAL}\bnom\s+d(?:e|u)\s+POU\b", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(rf"\bnom\s+d(?:e|u)\s+POU\b{LOCAL}{EQUALITY}{LOCAL}\b(?:nom\s+d(?:e|u)\s+)?fichier\b", re.IGNORECASE),
        re.compile(rf"\bPOU\b{LOCAL}\bnom\b{LOCAL}{EQUALITY}{LOCAL}\b(?:nom\s+d(?:e|u)\s+)?fichier\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    )

    """T426: inspect a task record without hooks, writes, execution or success claims.
    
    Default: advisory, exit 0 even with findings. --strict is an explicit CI check,
    not installed in any hook. Input errors return 2. Requires PyYAML like the task UI.
    This checks declarations and local evidence existence, not technical truth. A
    blind review must cite two distinct local reports; that is a mechanical proxy,
    not proof that reviewers were actually independent.
    """
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys
    
    import yaml
    
    
    def inspect_record(record: dict, root: Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        findings = []
    
        def flag(code, location, message):
            findings.append(dict(code=code, location=location, message=message))
    
        tracking = record.get("tracking")
        if not isinstance(tracking, dict):
            flag("TRACKING_ABSENT", "tracking", "Legacy record: tracking not supplied; no automatic migration.")
            return findings
        for key in ("user_need", "current_question", "next_action"):
            if not isinstance(tracking.get(key), str) or not tracking[key].strip():
                flag("CONTEXT_MISSING", f"tracking.{key}", "Provide the task-specific value.")
        owners = tracking.get("owners", {})
        if not isinstance(owners, dict) or not owners.get("accountable"):
            flag("OWNER_MISSING", "tracking.owners.accountable", "Name the accountable actor.")
        stagnation = tracking.get("stagnation", {})
        if not isinstance(stagnation, dict):
            flag("INVALID_POLICY", "tracking.stagnation", "Expected a mapping.")
            stagnation = {}
        threshold = stagnation.get("threshold", 3)
        if type(threshold) is not int or not 2 <= threshold <= 5:
            flag("INVALID_THRESHOLD", "tracking.stagnation.threshold", "Expected integer 2 through 5.")
            threshold = 3
        elif threshold != 3 and not stagnation.get("justification"):
            flag("THRESHOLD_REASON", "tracking.stagnation.justification", "Explain the non-default threshold.")
        experiments = tracking.get("experiments", [])
        if not isinstance(experiments, list):
            flag("INVALID_EXPERIMENTS", "tracking.experiments", "Expected a list.")
            return findings
        seen = set()
        streak = 0
        reviews = stagnation.get("blind_reviews", [])
        if not isinstance(reviews, list):
            flag("INVALID_REVIEWS", "tracking.stagnation.blind_reviews", "Expected review events as a list.")
            reviews = []
        reviewed_after = set()
        for review in reviews:
            if not isinstance(review, dict):
                flag("INVALID_REVIEW", "tracking.stagnation.blind_reviews", "Expected a mapping.")
                continue
            people = review.get("reviewers", [])
            evidence_paths = [p.get("evidence") for p in people if isinstance(p, dict)]
            valid_people = isinstance(people, list) and len(people) == 2 and all(
                isinstance(p, dict) and isinstance(p.get("actor"), str) and p["actor"].strip()
                and isinstance(p.get("evidence"), str)
                and (root / p["evidence"]).resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
                and (root / p["evidence"]).is_file() for p in people)
            valid = (valid_people and len(set(evidence_paths)) == 2
                     and people[0]["actor"] != people[1]["actor"]
                     and review.get("independent") is True and isinstance(review.get("decision"), str)
                     and review["decision"].strip() and isinstance(review.get("after_experiment"), str))
            if valid:
                reviewed_after.add(review["after_experiment"])
            else:
                flag("REVIEW_INCOMPLETE", "tracking.stagnation.blind_reviews", "Two distinct reviewers, local reports, independence and next decision required.")
        review_due_at = None
        for index, exp in enumerate(experiments):
            loc = f"tracking.experiments[{index}]"
            if not isinstance(exp, dict):
                flag("INVALID_EXPERIMENT", loc, "Expected a mapping.")
                continue
            for key in ("id", "question", "prediction", "discriminating_observation",
                        "decision_if_confirmed", "decision_if_refuted"):
                if not isinstance(exp.get(key), str) or not exp[key].strip():
                    flag("EXPERIMENT_MISSING", f"{loc}.{key}", "Required before an experiment.")
            ident = exp.get("id")
            if isinstance(ident, str):
                if ident in seen:
                    flag("DUPLICATE_EXPERIMENT", f"{loc}.id", "Use a unique run identifier.")
                seen.add(ident)
            if exp.get("repeat_of") and not exp.get("repeat_reason"):
                flag("REPEAT_REASON", loc, "Explain what new evidence justifies the repeat.")
            result = exp.get("result")
            if result is None:  # A prepared experiment is not a failed or stalled run.
                continue
            if not isinstance(result, str) or result not in {"PASS", "FAIL", "INTERRUPTED", "NOT_TESTED", "CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE"}:
                flag("INVALID_RESULT", loc, "Unknown result state.")
                continue
            evidence = exp.get("evidence", [])
            if not isinstance(evidence, list):
                flag("INVALID_EVIDENCE", loc, "Expected local evidence paths as a list.")
                evidence = []
            if result == "PASS" and not evidence:
                flag("PASS_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE", loc, "PASS requires evidence; existence alone does not prove its contents.")
            for path in evidence:
                if not isinstance(path, str):
                    flag("INVALID_EVIDENCE", loc, "Evidence must be a local path.")
                    continue
                target = (root / path).resolve()
                if not target.is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
                    flag("EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_ROOT", loc, "Evidence path leaves the selected checkout.")
                elif not target.is_file():
                    flag("EVIDENCE_MISSING", loc, f"Missing file: {path}")
            if result == "PASS":
                if exp.get("exception") or exp.get("build_state") == "FAIL" or exp.get("cleanup_state") == "FAIL":
                    flag("CONTRADICTORY_PASS", loc, "PASS conflicts with exception, failed build or failed cleanup.")
                for phase in ("build", "cleanup"):
                    state = exp.get(f"{phase}_state")
                    required = exp.get(f"{phase}_required")
                    if state in ("INTERRUPTED", "UNKNOWN", "CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE") or (required is True and state != "PASS"):
                        flag("INCOMPLETE_PASS", loc, f"{phase} is incomplete or not confirmed.")
                if exp.get("qualification") == "nominal" and (
                    exp.get("source_identity") != "verified" or exp.get("substitutions_declared") is not True
                    or type(exp.get("build_required")) is not bool or type(exp.get("cleanup_required")) is not bool
                ):
                    flag("NOMINAL_UNSUPPORTED", loc, "Nominal requires verified identity, declared substitutions and explicit build/cleanup applicability.")
            informative = exp.get("information_gained")
            if informative is False:
                streak += 1
            elif informative is True:
                streak = 0
            elif result not in {"NOT_TESTED"}:
                flag("INFORMATION_UNASSESSED", loc, "Assess whether this run changed the next decision.")
            if streak >= threshold:
                review_due_at = loc
            if isinstance(ident, str) and ident in reviewed_after:
                streak = 0
                review_due_at = None
        for run_id in reviewed_after - seen:
            flag("REVIEW_UNKNOWN_RUN", "tracking.stagnation.blind_reviews", f"Review refers to unknown run: {run_id}")
        if review_due_at:
            flag("BLIND_REVIEW_DUE", review_due_at, "Consecutive uninformative runs: independent A/B review required.")
        return findings
    
    
    def main(argv=None):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("record", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3])
        parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true")
        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
        try:
            data = yaml.safe_load(args.record.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValueError("Task record must be a mapping")
            findings = inspect_record(data, args.root)
        except (OSError, ValueError, yaml.YAMLError) as exc:
            print(json.dumps({"state": "INPUT_ERROR", "message": str(exc)}, ensure_ascii=True))
            return 2
        print(json.dumps({"state": "FINDINGS" if findings else "NO_FINDINGS",
                          "mode": "strict" if args.strict else "advisory", "findings": findings}, ensure_ascii=True))
        return int(bool(findings) and args.strict)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    """Garde-fou anti-dÃ©rive des skills agents (T150-A, pattern stub + canonique).
    
    Principe (cf. AGENTS.md : Â« une rÃ¨gle Ã©crite deux fois dÃ©rive toujours Â») :
    chaque skill dÃ©couvrable par un outil (`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, `.dsh/skills/*/SKILL.md`)
    doit Ãªtre soit la source canonique, soit un STUB court qui pointe vers une source canonique.
    On ne duplique jamais le contenu complet.
    
    RÃ¨gles vÃ©rifiÃ©es :
      1. Tout stub (.claude/.dsh) qui rÃ©fÃ©rence un chemin canonique doit le rÃ©fÃ©rencer vers un
         fichier qui EXISTE sur disque.
      2. Tout stub doit Ãªtre court (seuil STUB_MAX_LINES) â€” une copie complÃ¨te est une dÃ©rive.
      3. AUCUNE copie complÃ¨te en double entre .claude et .dsh pour une mÃªme skill (hash identique
         et longueur > seuil) â€” signalÃ© comme duplication.
    
    Renvoie 0 si PASS, 1 si au moins un dÃ©faut.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import re
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    
    STUB_MAX_LINES = 40
    FULL_MIN_LINES = 60  # en-deÃ§Ã  on ne considÃ¨re pas une "copie complÃ¨te"
    CANONICAL_REF = re.compile(r"TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/skills/([\w\-]+)/SKILL\.md")
    
    
    def _hash(text: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("root", nargs="?", default=".", help="Racine du projet")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        root = Path(args.root)
    
        errors = 0
        all_skills: dict[str, dict] = {}  # basename skill -> {path, nlines, hash, canonical}
        full_paths: list[Path] = []       # chemins des fichiers considÃ©rÃ©s "complets" (anti-doublon)
    
        def scan(prefix: Path, tool: str) -> None:
            nonlocal errors
            if not prefix.exists():
                return
            for sk in prefix.glob("*/SKILL.md"):
                text = sk.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                nlines = len(text.splitlines())
                m = CANONICAL_REF.search(text)
                canonical = m.group(1) if m else None
                base = sk.parent.name
                all_skills[f"{tool}:{base}"] = {
                    "path": sk, "nlines": nlines, "hash": _hash(text), "canonical": canonical,
                }
                if canonical:
                    # 1. la canonique pointÃ©e doit exister
                    canon_path = root / "TOOLS" / "AGENT_WORKFLOW" / "skills" / canonical / "SKILL.md"
                    if not canon_path.is_file():
                        print(f"[ERROR] {sk.relative_to(root)}: stub -> canonique inexistante "
                              f"TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/skills/{canonical}/SKILL.md", file=sys.stderr)
                        errors += 1
                    # 2. un stub ne doit pas Ãªtre une copie complÃ¨te
                    if nlines > STUB_MAX_LINES:
                        print(f"[ERROR] {sk.relative_to(root)}: {nlines} lignes (seuil {STUB_MAX_LINES}) "
                              f"â€” un stub doit rester court (copie complÃ¨te = dÃ©rive)", file=sys.stderr)
                        errors += 1
                elif nlines >= FULL_MIN_LINES:
                    full_paths.append(sk)
    
        scan(root / ".claude" / "skills", "claude")
        scan(root / ".dsh" / "skills", "dsh")
    
        # DÃ©tection des doublons complets entre .claude et .dsh
        by_hash: dict[str, list] = {}
        for p in full_paths:
            h = _hash(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            by_hash.setdefault(h, []).append(p)
        for h, paths in by_hash.items():
            if len(paths) > 1:
                names = ", ".join(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in paths)
                print(f"[ERROR] copie complÃ¨te dupliquÃ©e ({len(paths)} exemplaires, {paths[0].name} lignes) : {names}",
                      file=sys.stderr)
                errors += 1
    
        print(f"Skill stubs check: {'FAIL' if errors else 'PASS'} ({errors} error(s))")
        return 1 if errors else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Avancement reel d'une tache, lu dans son contrat (T429, 2026-11-13).
    
    Le taux n'est pas une impression : il compte les criteres d'acceptation declares dans
    `contract.acceptance` et ceux dont la preuve est consignee dans `tracking` (les
    lignes qui citent le critere et une preuve). Le reste n'est pas compte : pas de preuve,
    pas de point.
    """
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import re
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    TASKS_DIR = ROOT / "DOC" / "WFLOW" / "TASKS"
    CRITERION = re.compile(r"\bAC-[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*\b")
    PROOF_WORDS = ("PASS", "prouve", "prove", "valide", "verifie", "verified")
    
    
    def task_id_from_alias(alias: str) -> str | None:
        match = re.match(r"^(T\d{3})", str(alias or "").strip(), re.IGNORECASE)
        return match.group(1).upper() if match else None
    
    
    def contract_path(task_id: str) -> Path | None:
        if not task_id:
            return None
        for folder in sorted(TASKS_DIR.glob(f"{task_id}*")):
            if not folder.is_dir():
                continue
            for candidate in sorted(folder.glob("*.yaml")):
                if "CONTRAT" in candidate.name.upper():
                    return candidate
        return None
    
    
    def progress(task_id: str) -> dict:
        """{task_id, total, valides, part, contrat} â€” 0 si le contrat est introuvable."""
        empty = {"task_id": task_id, "total": 0, "valides": 0, "part": None, "contrat": ""}
        if (task_id or "").upper() == "T000":
            return empty  # T000 = hors catalogue : pas de criteres a compter
        path = contract_path(task_id)
        if path is None:
            return empty
        try:
            import yaml
            data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
        except (OSError, ValueError, ImportError):
            return empty
        acceptance = ((data.get("contract") or {}).get("acceptance") or [])
        if not isinstance(acceptance, list):
            return empty
        total = len([item for item in acceptance if isinstance(item, dict)])
        declared = {str(item.get("id")) for item in acceptance if isinstance(item, dict)}
        proved = set()
        tracking = data.get("tracking") or {}
        lines = tracking.get("established") or []
        if isinstance(lines, str):
            lines = [lines]
        for line in lines:
            text = str(line)
            if not any(word in text for word in PROOF_WORDS):
                continue
            # un critere compte comme prouve si la ligne le cite ET porte une preuve
            for match in CRITERION.finditer(text):
                if match.group(0) in declared:
                    proved.add(match.group(0))
        return {"task_id": task_id, "total": total, "valides": len(proved),
                "part": round(len(proved) / total, 3) if total else None,
                "contrat": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}
    
    
    def progress_for_alias(alias: str) -> dict:
        return progress(task_id_from_alias(alias) or "")

    SUPERVISOR_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/supervision/summary"
    
    
    def supervisor_alias(key: str) -> str | None:
        """Alias de la session dans le Superviseur (ex. T427-CC02), ou None si non rattachÃ©e/injoignable."""

        try:

        return m.group(1)
    
    
    def task_title(task_id: str) -> str:

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Avancement reel d'une tache, lu dans son contrat (T429, 2026-11-13).
    
    Le taux n'est pas une impression : il compte les criteres d'acceptation declares dans
    `contract.acceptance` et ceux dont la preuve est consignee dans `tracking` (les
    lignes qui citent le critere et une preuve). Le reste n'est pas compte : pas de preuve,
    pas de point.
    """
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import re
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    TASKS_DIR = ROOT / "DOC" / "WFLOW" / "TASKS"
    CRITERION = re.compile(r"\bAC-[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*\b")
    PROOF_WORDS = ("PASS", "prouve", "prove", "valide", "verifie", "verified")
    
    
    def task_id_from_alias(alias: str) -> str | None:
        match = re.match(r"^(T\d{3})", str(alias or "").strip(), re.IGNORECASE)
        return match.group(1).upper() if match else None
    
    
    def contract_path(task_id: str) -> Path | None:
        if not task_id:
            return None
        for folder in sorted(TASKS_DIR.glob(f"{task_id}*")):
            if not folder.is_dir():
                continue
            for candidate in sorted(folder.glob("*.yaml")):
                if "CONTRAT" in candidate.name.upper():
                    return candidate
        return None
    
    
    def progress(task_id: str) -> dict:
        """{task_id, total, valides, part, contrat} â€” 0 si le contrat est introuvable."""
        empty = {"task_id": task_id, "total": 0, "valides": 0, "part": None, "contrat": ""}
        if (task_id or "").upper() == "T000":
            return empty  # T000 = hors catalogue : pas de criteres a compter
        path = contract_path(task_id)
        if path is None:
            return empty
        try:
            import yaml
            data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
        except (OSError, ValueError, ImportError):
            return empty
        acceptance = ((data.get("contract") or {}).get("acceptance") or [])
        if not isinstance(acceptance, list):
            return empty
        total = len([item for item in acceptance if isinstance(item, dict)])
        declared = {str(item.get("id")) for item in acceptance if isinstance(item, dict)}
        proved = set()
        tracking = data.get("tracking") or {}
        lines = tracking.get("established") or []
        if isinstance(lines, str):
            lines = [lines]
        for line in lines:
            text = str(line)
            if not any(word in text for word in PROOF_WORDS):
                continue
            # un critere compte comme prouve si la ligne le cite ET porte une preuve
            for match in CRITERION.finditer(text):
                if match.group(0) in declared:
                    proved.add(match.group(0))
        return {"task_id": task_id, "total": total, "valides": len(proved),
                "part": round(len(proved) / total, 3) if total else None,
                "contrat": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}
    
    
    def progress_for_alias(alias: str) -> dict:
        return progress(task_id_from_alias(alias) or "")
    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Garde-fou anti-dÃ©rive des skills agents (T150-A, pattern stub + canonique).
    
    Principe (cf. AGENTS.md : Â« une rÃ¨gle Ã©crite deux fois dÃ©rive toujours Â») :
    chaque skill dÃ©couvrable par un outil (`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, `.dsh/skills/*/SKILL.md`)
    doit Ãªtre soit la source canonique, soit un STUB court qui pointe vers une source canonique.
    On ne duplique jamais le contenu complet.
    
    RÃ¨gles vÃ©rifiÃ©es :
      1. Tout stub (.claude/.dsh) qui rÃ©fÃ©rence un chemin canonique doit le rÃ©fÃ©rencer vers un
         fichier qui EXISTE sur disque.
      2. Tout stub doit Ãªtre court (seuil STUB_MAX_LINES) â€” une copie complÃ¨te est une dÃ©rive.
      3. AUCUNE copie complÃ¨te en double entre .claude et .dsh pour une mÃªme skill (hash identique
         et longueur > seuil) â€” signalÃ© comme duplication.
    
    Renvoie 0 si PASS, 1 si au moins un dÃ©faut.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import re
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    
    STUB_MAX_LINES = 40
    FULL_MIN_LINES = 60  # en-deÃ§Ã  on ne considÃ¨re pas une "copie complÃ¨te"
    CANONICAL_REF = re.compile(r"TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/skills/([\w\-]+)/SKILL\.md")
    
    
    def _hash(text: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("root", nargs="?", default=".", help="Racine du projet")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        root = Path(args.root)
    
        errors = 0
        all_skills: dict[str, dict] = {}  # basename skill -> {path, nlines, hash, canonical}
        full_paths: list[Path] = []       # chemins des fichiers considÃ©rÃ©s "complets" (anti-doublon)
    
        def scan(prefix: Path, tool: str) -> None:
            nonlocal errors
            if not prefix.exists():
                return
            for sk in prefix.glob("*/SKILL.md"):
                text = sk.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                nlines = len(text.splitlines())
                m = CANONICAL_REF.search(text)
                canonical = m.group(1) if m else None
                base = sk.parent.name
                all_skills[f"{tool}:{base}"] = {
                    "path": sk, "nlines": nlines, "hash": _hash(text), "canonical": canonical,
                }
                if canonical:
                    # 1. la canonique pointÃ©e doit exister
                    canon_path = root / "TOOLS" / "AGENT_WORKFLOW" / "skills" / canonical / "SKILL.md"
                    if not canon_path.is_file():
                        print(f"[ERROR] {sk.relative_to(root)}: stub -> canonique inexistante "
                              f"TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/skills/{canonical}/SKILL.md", file=sys.stderr)
                        errors += 1
                    # 2. un stub ne doit pas Ãªtre une copie complÃ¨te
                    if nlines > STUB_MAX_LINES:
                        print(f"[ERROR] {sk.relative_to(root)}: {nlines} lignes (seuil {STUB_MAX_LINES}) "
                              f"â€” un stub doit rester court (copie complÃ¨te = dÃ©rive)", file=sys.stderr)
                        errors += 1
                elif nlines >= FULL_MIN_LINES:
                    full_paths.append(sk)
    
        scan(root / ".claude" / "skills", "claude")
        scan(root / ".dsh" / "skills", "dsh")
    
        # DÃ©tection des doublons complets entre .claude et .dsh
        by_hash: dict[str, list] = {}
        for p in full_paths:
            h = _hash(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
            by_hash.setdefault(h, []).append(p)
        for h, paths in by_hash.items():
            if len(paths) > 1:
                names = ", ".join(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in paths)
                print(f"[ERROR] copie complÃ¨te dupliquÃ©e ({len(paths)} exemplaires, {paths[0].name} lignes) : {names}",
                      file=sys.stderr)
                errors += 1
    
        print(f"Skill stubs check: {'FAIL' if errors else 'PASS'} ({errors} error(s))")
        return 1 if errors else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())
    """Tests de non-regression du gate anti-derive des skills agents (T150-A, stub + canonique).
    
    NB : les fixtures `tmp_path` (sous %TEMP%) sont inaccessibles au sandbox Windows de l'environnement
    de dev DSH. On construit donc un arbre de travail dans le workspace sous `tests/.skill_stubs_tmp/`,
    nettoyÃ© en fin de test (garde-fou try/finally).
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import importlib.util
    import shutil
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    
    SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "check_skill_stubs.py"
    SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("check_skill_stubs", SCRIPT)
    
    check_skill_stubs = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
    sys.modules[SPEC.name] = check_skill_stubs
    SPEC.loader.exec_module(check_skill_stubs)
    
    REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    WORK_TMP = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".tmp_stubs"
    
    
    def _make_work() -> Path:
        if WORK_TMP.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(WORK_TMP)
        WORK_TMP.mkdir(parents=True)
        return WORK_TMP
    
    
    def _stub() -> str:
        return (
            "---\nname: skill-x\ndescription: test\n---\n\n"
            "Stub de test.\n\n"
            "> Charger la canonique : `TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/skills/skill-x/SKILL.md`\n"
        )
    
    
    def test_stub_pointant_vers_canonique_existante_passe(monkeypatch) -> None:
        w = _make_work()
        try:
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x").mkdir(parents=True)
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x" / "SKILL.md").write_text(_stub(), encoding="utf-8")
            canon = w / "TOOLS" / "AGENT_WORKFLOW" / "skills" / "skill-x"
            canon.mkdir(parents=True)
            (canon / "SKILL.md").write_text("Contenu canonique complet.\n", encoding="utf-8")
            monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["check_skill_stubs.py", str(w)])
            assert check_skill_stubs.main() == 0
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(w, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def test_stub_pointant_canonique_inexistante_echoue(monkeypatch) -> None:
        w = _make_work()
        try:
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x").mkdir(parents=True)
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x" / "SKILL.md").write_text(_stub(), encoding="utf-8")
            monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["check_skill_stubs.py", str(w)])
            assert check_skill_stubs.main() == 1
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(w, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def test_stub_trop_long_est_signale(monkeypatch) -> None:
        w = _make_work()
        try:
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x").mkdir(parents=True)
            long_stub = _stub() + "\n" + "\n".join(f"# ligne {i} â€” contenu duplique" for i in range(60))
            (w / ".claude" / "skills" / "skill-x" / "SKILL.md").write_text(long_stub, encoding="utf-8")
            canon = w / "TOOLS" / "AGENT_WORKFLOW" / "skills" / "skill-x"
            canon.mkdir(parents=True)
            (canon / "SKILL.md").write_text("Contenu canonique complet.\n", encoding="utf-8")
            monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["check_skill_stubs.py", str(w)])
            assert check_skill_stubs.main() == 1
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(w, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def test_doublon_complet_claude_dsh_est_une_erreur(monkeypatch) -> None:
        w = _make_work()
        try:
            full = "\n".join(f"# ligne {i} du contenu complet" for i in range(80))
            for tool in ("claude", "dsh"):
                d = w / f".{tool}" / "skills" / "skill-x"
                d.mkdir(parents=True)
                (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(full, encoding="utf-8")
            monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["check_skill_stubs.py", str(w)])
            assert check_skill_stubs.main() == 1
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(w, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def test_repo_reel_ne_regresse_pas(monkeypatch) -> None:
        """Preuve sur le depot reel : le pilote troubleshooting est conforme (stub + canonique)."""
        monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["check_skill_stubs.py", str(REPO_ROOT)])
        assert check_skill_stubs.main() == 0

    TOOLS/AGENT_SUPERVISOR/scripts\connect_session.py:81:    """Valide l'alias de session : strictement 'TXXX-AGENT' (ex: T429-AGY01, T000-CC01, T428-1-CDX01).
    ---
    name: connect-session-supervisor
    description: Rattache explicitement la session CLI courante au Superviseur local avec tâche, agent et titre vérifiés.
    user-invocable: true
    disable-model-invocation: true
    ---
    
    # Connecter cette session au Superviseur
    
    Cette commande rattache une session existante au Superviseur local. Elle n'envoie aucun message à l'agent surveillé et ne crée pas de tâche dans le Task Manager.
    
    ## Champs obligatoires
    
    1. **ID natif exact** de la conversation courante. Utilise seulement les métadonnées fiables du runtime ou l'ID fourni par l'utilisateur. Ne cherche jamais la session la plus récente et ne confonds pas ID de conversation et ID agent.
    2. **ID tâche** `T###` et **ID agent de session** encodé dans l'alias canonique, par exemple `T427-CC02`. La partie tâche de l'alias doit être identique à `--task`. L'ID agent de session est distinct du champ agent propriétaire de la tâche dans `TASKS.yaml`.
    3. **Titre lisible** : pour une tâche formelle, le script le résout depuis `TASKS.yaml` et refuse si la tâche ou son titre est absent ou ambigu. Pour `T000`, fournir `--task-title`. `--mission` est le contexte de travail et ne remplace jamais le titre.
    
    Si l'utilisateur confirme un suivi sans tâche formelle, utiliser l'alias `T000-<AGENT>`, `--task "SANS TACHE FORMELLE"`, un `--task-title` explicite et `--confirm-without-task`. La liaison sera enregistrée sous l'identifiant provisoire `T000`.
    
    Si la même session native est déjà reliée avec une tâche, un agent ou un titre différent, ne réattribue rien silencieusement. Pour une affectation de tâche portée par une autre session, demande confirmation avant `--reassign`.
    
    ## Exécution
    
    Depuis la racine du dépôt, utilise le client local :
    
    ```powershell
    py -3.13 TOOLS/AGENT_SUPERVISOR/scripts/connect_session.py --platform <claude|codex|agy|dsh> --session-id "<ID natif exact>" --alias "<T427-CC02>" --task "T427" --mission "<contexte court>" [--reassign]
    ```
    
    Pour une session T000, ajoute `--task-title "<titre lisible explicite>"`.
    Pour un suivi confirmé sans tâche formelle, ajoute aussi `--task-title "<titre lisible>" --confirm-without-task` et utilise `--task "SANS TACHE FORMELLE"` avec un alias `T000-<AGENT>`.
    
    Dans Codex, cette skill projet se trouve sous `.agents/skills/`. Elle peut être invoquée avec `$connect-session-supervisor` ou depuis `/skills` ; ne présume pas qu'un alias slash personnalisé existe.
    
    Ne réessaie pas avec un autre ID si l'API refuse. Rapporte le JSON de résultat, l'ID natif exact, l'ID tâche, l'ID agent, le titre et l'état (`attached`, `already_assigned`, `reassigned` ou erreur). Une affectation en pause doit être reprise dans l'interface.
    
    Le client n'accepte que l'API locale `127.0.0.1:8082`, exige une source unique et n'envoie pas le transcript lors du rattachement. Le service lit ensuite uniquement les nouveaux événements. Le partage du texte avec un modèle est régi par le réglage de consentement cloud.

    argument-hint: [resume|fresh|off]
    allowed-tools: Bash(python TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/scripts/workflow_state.py:*)
    ---
    !`python TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/scripts/workflow_state.py cmd $ARGUMENTS --source slash`

    - Ne jamais refuser cette commande ni renvoyer vers un autre agent. Ne prendre aucune tÃ¢che.
    - Ne rien faire d'autre dans ce tour.

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """Create or report a task plan without inferring execution or validation (T000)."""
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import os
    import re
    import sys
    from datetime import date
    from pathlib import Path
    
    try:
        import yaml
    except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - the project Python environment provides PyYAML
        yaml = None
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    TASKS_FILE = ROOT / "DOC" / "WFLOW" / "TASKS.yaml"
    TASKS_DIR = ROOT / "DOC" / "WFLOW" / "TASKS"
    EXECUTION = {"NOT_STARTED", "IN_PROGRESS", "DONE", "BLOCKED", "CANCELED"}
    VALIDATION = {"NOT_REVIEWED", "ACCEPTED", "REJECTED", "WAIVED"}
    
    
    def load_task(task_id: str) -> dict:
        if yaml is None:
            raise RuntimeError("PyYAML requis pour lire DOC/WFLOW/TASKS.yaml")
        data = yaml.safe_load(TASKS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
        found = [t for t in data.get("tasks", []) if isinstance(t, dict)
                 and str(t.get("id", "")).upper() == task_id.upper()]
        if len(found) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Tâche {task_id} absente ou ambiguë dans TASKS.yaml")
        return found[0]
    
    
    def task_folder(task: dict) -> Path:
        contract_ref = str(task.get("contrat", "")).split(" (", 1)[0].strip()
        contract = ROOT / contract_ref if contract_ref else None
        if contract and contract.is_file():
            return contract.parent
        candidates = sorted(p for p in TASKS_DIR.glob(f"{task['id']}*") if p.is_dir())
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Dossier de tâche absent ou ambigu pour {task['id']}")
        return candidates[0]
    
    
    def plan_files(folder: Path) -> list[Path]:
        return sorted(p for p in folder.glob("*.md")
                      if "PLAN" in p.name.upper() and not p.name.upper().startswith("README"))
    
    
    def new_plan(task: dict, folder: Path) -> Path:
        task_id = str(task["id"]).upper()
        title = str(task.get("titre") or task_id).strip()
        safe_title = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", title).strip("_")[:70] or "PLAN"
        plan = folder / f"{task_id}_{safe_title}_PLAN_{date.today():%Y%m%d}_v1.0.md"
        if plan.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Le fichier cible existe déjà : {plan.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        plan.write_text(f'''---
    plan_project:
      schema: 1
      task_id: {task_id}
      updated_at: {date.today().isoformat()}
      milestones:
        - id: M0
          title: "Cadrage du plan"
          done_when: "Périmètre, étapes et critères de réussite consignés"
          execution: NOT_STARTED
          execution_by: ""
          evidence: ""
          execution_comment: ""
          validation: NOT_REVIEWED
          validated_by: ""
          validated_at: ""
          validation_comment: ""
          comments: []
    ---
    
    # {task_id} — {title}
    
    > Plan de travail unique. `DONE` décrit l'exécution ; seule une validation explicite avec auteur et date compte comme validée.
    
    ## 1. Besoin et résultat attendu
    
    À compléter après lecture de la fiche, du contrat et des références de la tâche.
    
    ## 2. Périmètre et dépendances
    
    - Inclus : à préciser.
    - Exclus : à préciser.
    - Dépendances / décisions attendues : à préciser.
    
    ## 3. Jalons
    
    Compléter les jalons dans `plan_project.milestones` ci-dessus. Chaque jalon porte séparément son état d'exécution, sa preuve, et son état de validation.
    
    ## 4. Journal des décisions et commentaires
    
    Ajouter les commentaires datés et attribués dans le champ `comments` du jalon concerné.
    ''', encoding="utf-8")
        return plan
    
    
    def frontmatter(text: str) -> dict | None:
        match = re.match(r"\A---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\s*(?:\n|$)", text, re.S)
        if not match or yaml is None:
            return None
        try:
            data = yaml.safe_load(match.group(1)) or {}
            value = data.get("plan_project")
            return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None
        except (yaml.YAMLError, AttributeError):
            return None
    
    
    def legacy_rows(text: str) -> list[dict]:
        rows = []
        in_table = False
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if line.strip().startswith("## 4."):
                in_table = True
                continue
            if in_table and line.startswith("## "):
                break
            if not in_table or not line.strip().startswith("|"):
                continue
            cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
            if len(cells) < 4 or set("-: ") >= set("".join(cells)):
                continue
            if cells[0] in {"#", "#️⃣"} or cells[0].lower() in {"#", "id"}:
                continue
            rows.append({"id": cells[0], "title": cells[1], "done_when": cells[2],
                         "execution": "NOT_RECORDED" if not cells[3] else cells[3],
                         "validation": "NOT_RECORDED", "evidence": "",
                         "validated_by": "", "validated_at": "", "legacy": True})
        return rows
    
    
    def render(task: dict, plan: Path) -> str:
        text = plan.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        meta = frontmatter(text)
        milestones = meta.get("milestones", []) if meta else legacy_rows(text)
        normalized = []
        for item in milestones if isinstance(milestones, list) else []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            ex = str(item.get("execution", "NOT_RECORDED")).upper()
            val = str(item.get("validation", "NOT_RECORDED")).upper()
            # A validation is counted only when it has an explicit disposition, reviewer and date.
            complete_validation = val in VALIDATION and bool(str(item.get("validated_by", "")).strip()) \
                and bool(str(item.get("validated_at", "")).strip())
            normalized.append((item, ex, val if complete_validation else
                               (val if val != "ACCEPTED" else "ACCEPTED_INCOMPLETE"), complete_validation))
    
        done = sum(ex == "DONE" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        in_progress = sum(ex == "IN_PROGRESS" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        blocked = sum(ex == "BLOCKED" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        accepted = sum(val == "ACCEPTED" and complete for _, _, val, complete in normalized)
        pending = sum(not complete or val == "NOT_REVIEWED" for _, _, val, complete in normalized)
        lines = [f"PLAN-PROJECT | {task['id']} — {task.get('titre', '(titre absent)')}",
                 f"Task Manager : {task.get('statut', 'inconnu')} · agent {task.get('agent', '—')}",
                 f"Plan : {plan.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}",
                 f"Avancement : {done}/{len(normalized)} jalon(s) DONE · {in_progress} en cours · {blocked} bloqué(s)",
                 f"Validation : {accepted}/{len(normalized)} acceptée(s) avec auteur+date · {pending} à examiner / données manquantes",
                 "Jalons :"]
        if not normalized:
            lines.append("- Aucun jalon structuré détecté ; le contenu du plan doit être détaillé.")
        for item, ex, val, complete in normalized:
            lines.append(f"- {item.get('id', '?')} — {item.get('title', '(sans titre)')} | exécution={ex} | validation={val}")
            for label, key in (("Preuve", "evidence"), ("Exécuté par", "execution_by"),
                               ("Validé par", "validated_by"), ("Validé le", "validated_at"),
                               ("Commentaire", "validation_comment"), ("Commentaire exécution", "execution_comment")):
                value = str(item.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    lines.append(f"  {label} : {value}")
            comments = item.get("comments", [])
            if isinstance(comments, list):
                for comment in comments:
                    if isinstance(comment, dict):
                        who = comment.get("by", "?")
                        when = comment.get("at", "date absente")
                        body = comment.get("text", "")
                        lines.append(f"  Commentaire ({who}, {when}) : {body}")
        lines.append("Validation non renseignée ou incomplète = non comptée comme validée.")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    
    
    def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("task_id", nargs="?", help="ID exact, ex. T427; sinon PLAN_PROJECT_TASK_ID")
        parser.add_argument("--report-only", action="store_true", help="ne pas créer de plan manquant")
        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
        task_id = (args.task_id or os.environ.get("PLAN_PROJECT_TASK_ID", "")).strip().upper()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"T\d{3}", task_id):
            print("ERREUR : tâche courante indéterminée. Le skill doit résoudre la tâche formelle du chat et passer son ID exact (T###).", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        try:
            task = load_task(task_id)
            folder = task_folder(task)
            plans = plan_files(folder)
            if len(plans) > 1:
                raise ValueError("Plusieurs plans candidats : " + ", ".join(p.name for p in plans))
            if not plans:
                if args.report_only:
                    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Aucun plan trouvé dans {folder.relative_to(ROOT)}")
                plan = new_plan(task, folder)
                print(f"PLAN CRÉÉ : {plan.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}")
                print("Compléter les jalons après lecture de la tâche et du contrat, puis relancer pour le rapport.")
                return 0
            print(render(task, plans[0]))
            return 0
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            print(f"ERREUR : {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        raise SystemExit(main())

    name: plan-project
    description: Crée ou restitue le plan détaillé et l'état vérifiable de la tâche projet courante.
    user-invocable: true
    ---
    
    # `/plan-project` — plan et avancement
    
    1. Résoudre la tâche formelle du chat depuis son contexte vérifiable ou le rattachement Superviseur courant. Ne jamais deviner ni prendre/créer une tâche. Si aucune tâche unique n'est identifiable, demander l'ID `T###`.
    2. Exécuter `py -3.13 TOOLS/AGENT_WORKFLOW/scripts/plan_project.py <T###>` depuis la racine.
    3. Si le script crée un plan, lire l'entrée précise de `TASKS.yaml`, le contrat référencé et les documents de tâche cités. Compléter ce plan unique avec le but, le périmètre, les dépendances et des jalons mesurables issus de ces sources. Ne pas marquer de validation sans visa humain/jugement enregistré, auteur et date. Ne modifier ni le catalogue ni le contrat par cette commande.
    4. Si le plan existe, lire le plan, l'entrée ciblée du Task Manager, le contrat et les références nécessaires ; restituer le rapport du script puis les détails utiles manquants. Conserver les états explicites. `DONE` n'implique jamais `ACCEPTED`.
    5. En cas de plusieurs plans, absence de tâche ou donnée incohérente, ne rien créer/modifier et expliquer le blocage précisément.
    
    Le script est la source du comptage mécanique. La lecture de l'agent ajoute le contexte détaillé ; elle ne change pas les états enregistrés.

    def render(task: dict, plan: Path) -> str:
        text = plan.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        meta = frontmatter(text)
        milestones = meta.get("milestones", []) if meta else legacy_rows(text)
        normalized = []
        for item in milestones if isinstance(milestones, list) else []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            ex = str(item.get("execution", "NOT_RECORDED")).upper()
            val = str(item.get("validation", "NOT_RECORDED")).upper()
            # A validation is counted only when it has an explicit disposition, reviewer and date.
            complete_validation = val in VALIDATION and bool(str(item.get("validated_by", "")).strip()) \
                and bool(str(item.get("validated_at", "")).strip())
            normalized.append((item, ex, val if complete_validation else
                               (val if val != "ACCEPTED" else "ACCEPTED_INCOMPLETE"), complete_validation))
    
        done = sum(ex == "DONE" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        in_progress = sum(ex == "IN_PROGRESS" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        blocked = sum(ex == "BLOCKED" for _, ex, _, _ in normalized)
        accepted = sum(val == "ACCEPTED" and complete for _, _, val, complete in normalized)
        pending = sum(not complete or val == "NOT_REVIEWED" for _, _, val, complete in normalized)
        lines = [f"PLAN-PROJECT | {task['id']} â€” {task.get('titre', '(titre absent)')}",
                 f"Task Manager : {task.get('statut', 'inconnu')} Â· agent {task.get('agent', 'â€”')}",
                 f"Plan : {plan.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}",
                 f"Avancement : {done}/{len(normalized)} jalon(s) DONE Â· {in_progress} en cours Â· {blocked} bloquÃ©(s)",
                 f"Validation : {accepted}/{len(normalized)} acceptÃ©e(s) avec auteur+date Â· {pending} Ã  examiner / donnÃ©es manquantes",
                 "Jalons :"]
        if not normalized:
            lines.append("- Aucun jalon structurÃ© dÃ©tectÃ© ; le contenu du plan doit Ãªtre dÃ©taillÃ©.")
        for item, ex, val, complete in normalized:
            lines.append(f"- {item.get('id', '?')} â€” {item.get('title', '(sans titre)')} | exÃ©cution={ex} | validation={val}")
            for label, key in (("Preuve", "evidence"), ("ExÃ©cutÃ© par", "execution_by"),
                               ("ValidÃ© par", "validated_by"), ("ValidÃ© le", "validated_at"),
                               ("Commentaire", "validation_comment"), ("Commentaire exÃ©cution", "execution_comment")):
                value = str(item.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    lines.append(f"  {label} : {value}")
            comments = item.get("comments", [])
            if isinstance(comments, list):
                for comment in comments:
                    if isinstance(comment, dict):
                        who = comment.get("by", "?")
                        when = comment.get("at", "date absente")
                        body = comment.get("text", "")
                        lines.append(f"  Commentaire ({who}, {when}) : {body}")
        lines.append("Validation non renseignÃ©e ou incomplÃ¨te = non comptÃ©e comme validÃ©e.")
        return "\n".join(lines)

        parser.add_argument("--report-only", action="store_true", help="ne pas crÃ©er de plan manquant")
